\section{Optimization Census of Accepted Competition Source Commits}
\label{sec:supp-census}

\benhuang{Working on this atm}

\jieyi{Gather the raw Claude/Codex prompt sessions from the participants. Add the sanitized version to Github, and provide a high-level overview here.}

This appendix lists every accepted source commit of the public competition
(\Cref{M:sec:anatomy}), assigned to its primary transformation family or residual
bucket---the same census summarized in \Cref{M:fig:family-census-tree}, here
expanded to one row per commit. Official operating points---\emph{Score}~$=$
average executed Toffoli $\times$ peak qubits (lower is better) and $\Delta$, the
score change versus the prior public frontier---are joined from the ecdsafail
leaderboard; they are not in the git history itself. Of the $404$ accepted
``Accept submission'' commits through 18 July, $400$ have leaderboard score
records: $397$ match the \texttt{promoted} rows in the 2 July ledger snapshot
used for the headline operating points, and three are later scored commits. The
remaining four are the contest's \texttt{DUMMY\_TOFFOLIS} bootstrap commits,
which went through the acceptance plumbing but were never scored and are marked
\emph{(unscored)}. Accepted source commits and current ledger-status rows are
therefore related archival views, not interchangeable counting units. Each
row's assignment is made by an audit of its actual \texttt{git show} diff (not
its commit subject or lever name, which are frequently unreliable), matching
\Cref{M:fig:family-census-tree}. Rows are grouped by family
in descending order of frequency---with the two residual buckets (verifier
search, neutral) and the unscored bootstrap group placed last---then by
change-type (level~2 of \Cref{M:fig:family-census-tree}), and within a change-type
by score (best first).

The largest recorded frontier delta belongs to the two-jump inversion base
(\texttt{cddd5df}, under Windowing), whose $\Delta$ is nearly one billion; it is the landed
\texttt{DIALOG\_GCD} reimplementation of the modular inverse. This ledger lists
all $404$ accepted commits, including the four unscored bootstrap rows---placed
in their own \emph{Unscored bootstrap} group---that \Cref{M:fig:family-census-tree}
excludes; on the $400$ scored source commits the ledger and the figure agree family
by family.
